scope: Fix a real bug: extension-drive-routes.js called callCouncilMember with the wrong argument shape and invalid member ids, causing every model tier to fail (all_tiers_failed) on the first real live-driven browser test.

steps.title: Fix callCouncilMember call shape -- was passing an object where a string prompt is required, and 'anthropic' where a real tier/member id is required
steps.task: makeCallModel called callCouncilMember('anthropic', {model,system,messages,max_tokens}) -- the real signature (confirmed against routes/general-browser-agent-routes.js's already-working usage) is callCouncilMember(member, promptString, {taskType}). Fix using PATCH MODE.
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only

steps.title: Fix tiers array to use real member identifiers instead of abstract cheap/strong labels
steps.task: tiers: ['cheap','strong'] don't correspond to any real callCouncilMember member id -- replace with the same real, proven-working tier list already used by general-browser-agent-routes.js. Using PATCH MODE.
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only
